messages:
noah: opened PR to clarify Rerank+Embedding compatibility in the model catalog. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1799. Need a short note about using rerank with sharded embeddings and an SDK snippet.

rita: can you add the concrete recommendation? e.g., 'use single-shard embeddings for rerank at low qps or aggregate shard outputs before scoring'

samir: agree. also call out that quantized embed variants may change vector magnitudes slightly -> recommend re-normalizing before cosine comparison.

noah: adding wording: "When using rerank with sharded embeddings, either route rerank requests to a dedicated single-shard endpoint or aggregate per-shard vectors and normalize before scoring. Quantized embeddings (q4) can change scale; apply L2 normalization and re-evaluate thresholds."

rita: please add short Python snippet showing aggregation+normalize.

noah: snippet draft:
```python
# aggregate per-shard embeddings and L2-normalize before rerank
from numpy.linalg import norm
embs = [e1, e2, e3]  # embeddings from shards
agg = sum(embs)      # elementwise sum
normed = agg / norm(agg)
# then compute cosine with query vector
```

samir: tiny nit: use np.sum(...) and handle zero-norm guard. also add link to embedding sharding guide.

doc-bot: preview built -> https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.io/docs/model-cards/rerank-embed-compat (status: success) :white_check_mark:

rita: LGTM. added a one-line migration tip for SDK v3 about batch param rename.

noah: merging in 10 if no objections.

samir: approved.
